name: Carcaixent (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Carcaixent (the bars of Aragon with a bow and arrow).
history: Municipal flag of Carcaixent; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Carcaixent arms — the bars of Aragon with a bow and arrow
